newsitem.title: USA: Most GenRad debentures converted to stock.
newsitem.headline: Most GenRad debentures converted to stock.

text.p: GenRad Inc said Thursday it $49.63 million of its 7-/4 percent convertible subordinated debt has been converted into common stock.
The remaining bonds were redeemed with cash in the amount of $372,000, it said.
The company also said it wil not need to use bridge financing from BankBoston Corp to redeem the bonds since most were converted into common stock.

GenRad said it will save about $3.6 million in interest expense each year with the issuance of 3.5 million new shares. After the issuance of the new shares, the company will have about 27.6 million shares outstanding by the end of the year.
The company said the new shares will not have a dilutive effect on earnings per share.
